messages:
maria: Putting up initial draft for the release notes covering per-route token-level cost insights and rollout controls. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4610 (branch: doc/relnotes-route-insights). Need reviewers for copy + example updates for SDK v2 + a brief known-issues section.
kai: Copying this thread into #eng for visibility. I'll own Node examples. Which files should I change?
maria: Examples are in `docs/examples/sdk/v2/node/` and `docs/content/release-notes/2025-09-route-insights.md`. Note: many node snippets still call `client.generate()` — migrate to `client.chat.create()` and update streaming patterns.
sam: I'll handle Python snippets and add a tiny snippet-test to verify output shape. Any migration blurb we want to include?
maria: Yes — short blurb: "Migration note: v1 `generate()` calls should become `chat.create()` with a messages array. See example below." Then a short code diff.
kai: Will replace the node streaming example too. Suggest we call it out as `chat.stream()` with `onDelta` and `onComplete` callbacks.
olivia: FYI staging preview shows the release-notes index 404 — looks like a redirect rule missing. I can open a small PR to fix Netlify redirects.
deploy-bot: Preview URL: https://deploy-preview-802--docs.redwood.ai — build done but 2 broken links detected (anchors: #pinned-routing and #streaming-limitations).
sam: I'll add the anchors to the relnotes doc and extend the Known issues section with the streaming truncation workaround. Proposed wording: "Streaming may truncate when system prompt + prefixes exceed KV cache; workaround: shorten system prompts or set `max_system_tokens` client-side".
maria: That wording is good. Also add note for Dedicated customers: pinned routing can fall back to compatible variants under load — recommend reserved capacity or pin to explicit variant.
kai: Node PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4613 — updated examples and added a short test harness. I included a streaming example and a short comment about delta vs final payload.
olivia: Netlify patch PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4615 — adds `_redirects` and fixes the relnotes index route.
sam: Python PR coming up. I'll include a `tests/snippets/test_relnotes_snippets.py` that runs the examples with the snippet-runner.
deploy-bot: Rebuild queued for 1756004520. Current link-checker: 2 broken anchors reported (pending PRs to add anchors).
maria: Please keep snippet changes separate so we can cherry-pick to maintenance branches. After PRs merge, I'll run a final editorial pass and tag marketing for the feature announcement. Target publish: next Tuesday. :thumbsup:
kai: Will ping when python PR is green.
olivia: Redirects PR ready.
sam: Python PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4614 — includes test and anchor fixes.
maria: Thanks everyone. Once the preview rebuild finishes and link-checker is clean I'll resolve this thread.
